reason: Evaluates inside a frame to get an element of the top document, then asks for that element's content frame. A frame has no `evaluateHandle` in Strider, and a handle can't cross from one frame's realm to another, so the frame's element can't be reached from inside it
On Firefox a loaded iframe's url in page.frames is about:blank
A loaded iframe's URL and navigations reach page.frames after the iframe's own load event, on Firefox
